tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje seng ge mtshan can la bka' gdams bu chos kyi sgo nas bstod pa bzhugs/ /

na mo ārya lo ki shwa ra ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus nas| |jo bo yab sras slar yang gangs can gyi/ /dwangs tshugs rgyas phyir phyogs 'dir sku sprul ba/ /lo chen skyabs mchog yab sras zhabs la 'dud/ 1/ khyad par dag gi mkhan po bka' drin can/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gtso/ khrims gtsang spyod pas kun gyi yid 'phrog pa/ /seng ge'i rgyan mtshan zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ 2 /khyed sngon ser skyar legs skyes yid 'ong ma'i// sras gcig bram ze gsal ba rig byed mkhas/ /chos 'dun ngang las myur bskul 'jigs med drung*/ /the tshom kun bcad sgrub la brtson phyag 'tshal/ 3/ ko'u sham bhir 'od dpal legs ldan ma'i/ /sras chung chags pa med pa khyim spangs te/ /chags med drung du gnyid rmugs le lo spangs/ /legs sgrubs chags med byin la phyag 'tshal lo/ 4 /yangs pa can du dga' rab dga' byed ma'i/ /sras chung kun du dga' bas mu stegs btul/ /'od zer snying pos rab byung dus kun tu/ /dran shes bag yod mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ 5 /wa ra na sir bsod 'phel lha sbyin ma'i// sras gcen lha skyes rang gi yon tan sbed// gzhan skyon mi brjaud yon tan brjod pa yi/ /dgra btul kun bzang drung song la phyag 'tshal/ 6 /bde ldan bde spyod kun tu bzang mo'i sras/ /dkon mchog 'bangs 'gyur yon tan sbas kyang mngon/ /u rgyan gnas nas gsang ba ye shes blangs| |kun kyang rdo rje theg par bkod phyag 'tshal/ 7 /bhaṃ gar bhaṃ ga nor sbyin ma yi sras/ /dad pa brtan pa bdud mos yab bsgyur nas/ /dka' ba du mas me tog ku sha blangs/ /ngo mtshar mang bstan 'gro kun skyabs la 'dud/ 8/ bhaṃ gar gsang dpal me tog gsal ba'i sras/ /dad pa rab brtan bdud mos kham rdar spyugs/ /btsun mo byi shar blon pos thabs kyis 'dums/ /gyos por drin gzos snying rjes bskyangs la 'dud/ 9 /rgya nag bon rtsar lcags 'bar lcags log sras/

/blo gros 'phel 'gyur btson kun myur du btang*// gnyis spangs zhabs btud bsil thang klu bdud btul/ /sdig med byams pas 'gro kun bskyangs la 'dud/ 10 /wa ra na sir dga' ba dga' 'od sras/ /gcen po jo bo nyer dga' rab tu byung/ khyod gcung dga' 'dzin khyim pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /sdig spangs mchog gsum dad pa brtan la 'dud/ 11 /wa ra na sir bsod 'dzin dpal mo'i sras/ /dge bsnyen btsun pa chos kyi mchog gis byin| |'byor pa che ldan khyim spangs dman chas 'tsho/ /'gro kun de ltar bkod la phyag 'tshal lo/ 12 /sgra bcas sgra 'dzin sgra 'phreng ma yi sras/ /nor bzang mar me mdzad bzang gis sprul pa'i/ /ka lan tā kas legs bskul rab tu byung*| |log 'tsho spangs shing 'phags nor bsgrubs la 'dud/ 13 /ma ga dhar ni nyi ma skal ldan sras/ /zla ba rig byed sogs mkhas smra ba'i mchog /mu stegs kun btul khyi'us pad zlum bstan/ /yon tan sbed par bsngags la phyag 'tshal lo/ 14 /sgra ldan rin chen gser 'phreng ma yi sras/ /rin chen snying po rin chen ma lus bskyed/ /'gro kun yid 'phrog yang dag 'tsho bar bkod// log 'tsho mtha' dag spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ 15 /sgra ldan zla bzang me tog 'dzin ma'i sras/ /pad mar khyod 'khrungs ba su ban rgyu sogs/ /mkhan slob chos ldan gang zag gus pas bkur/ /'gro kun pha mar 'dzin pas dus 'dar 'dud| 16 /yangs pa can du 'od dpal legs ldan ma/ /'od dpag med kyis byin rlabs 'od zer 'khrungs/ /mtsho skam klu nad nyer zhi bshes gnyen bsten| |sdig grogs rtag tu spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ 17 /yangs pa can du kun dga' legs sbyin sras/ /byams par khyod 'khrungs lce rtse'i 'od dkar ni// gang 'phog byams pa tshad med rgyud la skyes/ /bde ldan chags med spyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ 18 /rtswa mchog grong du dpa' bo go cha'i sras/ /seng ge sgra yi spyod nyes rgyal po btul/

/dang por gang brtsams dka' yang mthar son pa'i// brtul 'phod brtson 'grus ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ 19/rdo 'jog grong du bde ba bsam 'dzin sras/ /bde mchog ba lang skyong 'khrungs klu bdud btul/ /yab sras rgya mtsho sbas pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ /mkhas bsngags khengs bral man ngag dran phyag 'tshal/ 20 /ya mu na gling lha yi rgyal por 'khrungs/ khyim nas 'byung 'dod mar me mdzad kyis bkag/phyi dus mgon khyed sras bcas bod yul du// chos rgyal bstan 'dzin cher nges mdzad phyag 'tshal/ 21 /pad mo can zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du/ khyi'u dge 'dun 'phel zhes bya bar 'gyur/ /bsam sbyor kun gyi dge 'dun spel mdzad pa'i/ /phrin las khyad par can du gyur la 'dud/ 2/ khus btud mgon khyod wa ra na sir sngon/ /sro long kun tu rgyur 'khrungs dka' spyad kyis/ khrel gzhung blo btad thub pa'i rnam thar bstan/ /zhar byung skyes rabs mang gsung la phyag 'tshal/ 23 /bde ldan grong du rgyal bu skyabs sbyin gyur| |glang po'i ro bton blon pos bslus pa na/ /grong 'jug 'pho bas kun kyang bde la bkod/ /ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ 24/ dpal ldan gangs ri'i mgon po rgyal ston mchog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas che/ /smra ba'i seng ge thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /dpal 'byor bzang pos rtag tu skyong gyur cig 25 /ces pa bdag nyid chen po 'di las sdom gsum rdzogs par nos pa'i dge slong shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// //shubhaṃ// //'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gnas kyi 'khrungs rabs kyi sgo nas bstod pa 'di/ rje sku skye shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos zla mchod tshes brgyad kyi nyin bzhengs pa'o/ /'gro kun khyed kyis rjes bzung shog/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/rje seng ge mtshan can la bka' gdams bu chos kyi sgo nas bstod pa/
